claims.claim: An arXiv paper published 2026-10-15 introduced Harness-Delta Attribution
a protocol that splits an evolution gain into artifact-driven overfitting, gains explained by test-time scaling, and a remainder that upper-bounds residual generalizable improvement
The authors applied it to 11 executor models and three harness-evolution frameworks across math, coding, creativity, and agentic tasks
In 21 settings with statistically significant search-set gains, overfitting and test-time scaling accounted for 54% and 14% of the gain on average
the combined share above 50% in 14 settings
Search-set gains often failed to transfer to held-out tasks
validation-based signals were insufficient to prevent overfitting
